subject: pe
title: Healthy Eating: Plate Basics
welcome_lead: Build your plate well and energy follows.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: balanced plate, fruit, veg, carbs.
final_note: Half veg, quarter carb, quarter protein — easy.

concepts.def: Plate split into the right food groups.
Sweet plant food rich in vitamins.
How much you take for one meal.

walkthroughs.body_html: Fill half your plate with vegetables and salad — colour matters: aim for variety.
A quarter carbohydrates — rice, pasta, potatoes. Wholegrains where possible for fibre.
A quarter protein — chicken, fish, beans or tofu. Add a small amount of healthy fat or dairy.
